title: 65860 Edgewater Drive
description: Inviting 4-bedroom, 2-bath home on a desirable corner lot in the River Glen community of Yulee. The open floor plan offers generous living space filled with natural light, and the interior has been thoughtfully updated for modern style and convenience. Energy-efficient features — including solar panels, efficient windows, and appliances — help dramatically reduce utility costs. Outside, a fully fenced yard with a rear gate offers privacy and easy vehicle access, while River Glen residents enjoy a swimming pool, kiddie pool, and kayak launch, plus close proximity to parks, shopping, dining, and major roadways.
